name: Mood Blob
summary: A single teal blob whose outline is the system’s mood: bouncy when fine, stretched and bristling at the anomaly, a cushion once you decide.
look: Flat wellness-app illustration: warm paper, big pale discs, one organic teal blob with a two-dot face and coral cheeks; greys for the ‘before’ world.

components.name: Mood blob
components.role: Pulse: teal organic shape whose outline encodes system health

components.name: Two-dot face
components.role: minimal eyes + mouth; 4 states: up, wide, content, (grey) tired

components.name: Grey puddles
components.role: melted, colourless blobs = the overwhelmed team before Pulse

components.name: Floating card
components.role: one rounded white card with the anomaly readout

components.name: Flat person
components.role: simple geometric human who makes the decision

components.name: Soft discs
components.role: big pale circles behind each scene set the mood colour

motion.name: Squash & stretch bounce
motion.how: entry and exit on the drop: 0.5 s with elastic.out(1, 0.5); contact frames sit exactly on the downbeat

motion.name: Breathing idle
motion.how: scale 1↔1.03 on a 2-beat loop (1 s at 120 BPM) so the blob literally breathes with the tempo

motion.name: Outline noise
motion.how: a spike/wobble parameter on the outline animates 0→0.22 in 0.3 s for tension and back to 0 over one bar for relief

story: Hook: grey blobs melting beside a broken chart under 'And the drop still shipped on Friday.'. Reveal: a round teal blob bounces up beneath the Acme mark and 'Acme Pulse'. Proof: the blob stretches and bristles, reaching for a card with checkout −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231, while a person reaches for Roll back. CTA: the blob relaxes into a cushion under 'You ship. Pulse watches.' and Start free.
adapt: Give your product one blob in your brand colour and drive its outline from a real metric (health score, queue length, error rate); keep the face to two dots and a line.

references.note: Headspace’s shape language: a circle that morphs into expressive faces
state machines that switch a character between mood states from inputs

fit.risk: Soft and gentle can undersell urgency; make the tense state genuinely sharp (spikes, coral backdrop) and keep the data card precise.
